A '''merchandise code scanner''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]]. The [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]] had a merchandise code scanner installed in its single [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]].<ref name="EGTD" />
